English: Open Security app -> Autostart -> enable this app. Then Battery Saver -> No restrictions.\nHindi: Security app kholo -> Autostart me app ON karo. Phir Battery Saver me No restrictions select karo.
English: Open Phone Manager -> Auto Launch -> allow app. Disable battery optimization for this app.\nHindi: Phone Manager kholo -> Auto Launch me app allow karo. Battery optimization band karo.
English: Open iManager -> Background app management -> allow this app always.\nHindi: iManager kholo -> Background app management me is app ko always allow karo.

English: Open Device Care -> Battery -> Background usage limits -> Never sleeping apps add this app.\nHindi: Device Care kholo -> Battery -> Background limits -> Never sleeping apps me is app ko add karo.

English: Open System Manager -> App launch -> manage manually and allow auto launch, secondary launch, background run.\nHindi: System Manager kholo -> App launch -> manual manage karo aur sab permissions allow karo.
English: Open Security -> Battery optimization -> choose Don\'t optimize for this app.\nHindi: Security kholo -> Battery optimization -> is app ke liye Don\'t optimize choose karo.
English: Disable battery optimization for this app and allow overlay permission.\nHindi: Is app ke liye battery optimization band karo aur overlay permission allow karo.
